data.title: 朝田诗乃 · 杂志页间的熟悉名字
data.description: 周末采购时，诗乃穿灰蓝夹克在便利店杂志架前停下，用手指夹住游戏报道的一页。篮里是酸奶和面包，她稍稍推起眼镜，确认那张熟悉的比赛构图后，脸上浮出一个克制的笑。
data.action: 夹住熟悉的比赛报道，推好眼镜后轻轻微笑。
data.promptProse: Shino Asada pauses at the convenience-store magazine rack, marking a gaming-report page with one finger while pushing up her black glasses. Her slate-blue hooded jacket and grey knit top remain visible above a basket containing yogurt and bread. The medium view follows magazine shelves along the aisle. Soft shelf lighting falls onto the page and her restrained smile, with darker gaps between rows and a faint reflection on the basket handle.
